answer: Make every agent post a refundable stake before it can trade, slashed on proven fraud. One walnut-sized deposit looks cheap, but a Sybil farm must fund a separate bond for each fake identity, and the cost stacks like shale: every layer adds expense. Honest agents earn their stake back with fees, while an attacker operating in the cold tundra of untrusted space must keep refilling slashed bonds, so manufacturing fake volume costs more than the fraud can ever return.
